I grow beans on this small plot because they fix the soil and give my family food, but I save the little fertilizer I can get for my maize. My children and I will do all the work ourselves since the plot is right near the house and not too big. I will spread some manure from our goats on the beans to help them grow, but I cannot afford chemicals and the rains are enough without irrigation.
